messages:
pager-bot: [PAGER] Billing / Metering — token-count drift detected in eu-west-1 aggregator. Overflags spiking. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/metering-drift :rotating_light:
raj: ack, taking this
raj: quick triage — dashboards show token delta growing since 02:00 UTC, consumer lag ~18m on kafka-partition-14
emily: are customers seeing invoices yet? any billing emails sent?
raj: initial check: overage flags triggered but invoice pipeline hasn't cut. some alert emails queued in the emitter. pausing emitter now to avoid noisy customer alerts
mike: copying local snapshot, running quick check script
mike: ```json
{"partition":14,"lag":1800000,"queued_events":1203456,"last_processed_ts":"2026-03-20T02:05:30Z"}
```
raj: mitigation step 1: pausing overage-emitter in eu-west-1 -> `kubectl scale deployment overage-emitter -n billing-eu1 --replicas=0`
deploy-bot: started run: scale deployment overage-emitter to 0 in billing-eu1 (triggered by raj)
emily: starting recon job to sweep delayed usage to ledger (dry-run=false)
emily: `./scripts/reconcile_usage --since 2026-03-20T02:00Z --target=ledger-eu1` (kicked off)
sara: 👍 please hold any customer comms until we confirm final deltas
raj: paging eng-infra — possible broker/consumer GC or compaction storm causing backlog @eng-oncall
eng-oncall: looking at broker metrics now, consumer offsets look stalled. checking pod logs for aggregator-processor-3
eng-oncall: found long GC pause on aggregator-processor-3 at 02:12 (~45s) followed by retry storm — likely caused consumer stall
mike: temp fix: restarting aggregator-processor-3 to restore steady consumption -> `kubectl rollout restart deployment aggregator-processor -n billing-eu1 --selector=pod=aggregator-3`
deploy-bot: rollout started for deployment aggregator-processor in billing-eu1 (initiated by mike)
raj: after restart: backlog dropped from ~1.23M -> ~31k in ~6m. consumer lag back to acceptable range
emily: leaving emitter paused until recon finishes and we validate counts
raj: propose keep overage alerts suppressed for 60m, run full reconcile, evaluate customer impact window (02:00-02:20 UTC)
emily: agreed. I'll prepare a short internal summary and a potential customer note template if we need it
raj: assigning follow-up: eng-infra to investigate GC tuning + heap sizing for aggregator-processor; owners: raj + eng-infra; severity: sev3
pager-bot: Incident update: mitigation applied (emitter paused, aggregator restarted). Backlog cleared. Follow-up assigned to eng-infra for GC/heap tuning. Incident status: investigating -> monitored.
raj: leaving thread open for 2h to confirm no reoccurrence; will update if counts reappear
mike: postmortem owner: emily, will draft after stability check
emily: noted, creating ticket IN-1712347 in incident tracker once recon completes :thumbsup:
